description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for an RN passionate about clinical excellence and staff development within a supportive environment.In this permanent, full-time role, you will play a crucial part in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and mentoring nursing staff. We are looking for a leader committed to fostering a positive and effective clinical team, contributing to the overall success and well-being of our residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Proven leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA, as a Registered Nurse (RN) - MDS Coordinator. We are actively seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented professional to join our team promptly, contributing to our commitment to exceptional patient care and regulatory compliance. This is an excellent opportunity to leverage your clinical expertise in a supportive environment.In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing comprehensive care plans, and ensuring accurate documentation in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in optimizing resident outcomes and maintaining our high standards of quality.This full-time position offers a competitive salary, reflecting your valuable skills and experience. We are looking for a professional who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Previous experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF)
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations
